title: TrendBlender Brand Config
description: The contract between the trendblender-skeleton repo and the trendblender-onboard-brand skill. This is also the shape of the standalone brand-config.json artifact persisted per brand, independent of any built plugin, so a brand can be rebuilt against a newer skeleton version without re-interviewing.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS schema the config was written against, e.g. "1.0". Not the skeleton repo tag.

id.description: Slug used as the brandKey throughout the pipeline: window.TRENDS_DATA.<id>, file names, saved-search name prefixes.

category.description: One-line product/category description, e.g. "Surface care" or "Laundry detergent".

essence.description: One or two sentences of brand essence/positioning, in the client's own language.

archetype.description: Brand archetype / voice shorthand, e.g. "The Confident Restorer", used to keep generated prose in-voice.

logoText.description: Short text/wordmark shown in the dashboard header if no image asset is used.

name.description: Exact activation name. Trend records' activationMatch must equal one of these or null.

description.description: What counts as on-territory for this brand, in prose.

rejectList.description: Explicit off-territory patterns. Non-empty by design — every brand rejects something; an empty list is a sign the interview was skipped, not that the brand is universally on-topic.

pattern.description: What to reject, in plain English, e.g. "crypto/NFT/Web3 content".

reason.description: Why it's off-territory for this brand specifically.

pillars.description: Search pillars. Arbitrary length — not fixed to any prior brand's pillar count.

name.description: Client-facing pillar label. Never used verbatim in a trend name (see forbidden-jargon check).

description.description: Plain-English brief fed to unified_retrieval_query_gen_tool at onboarding/rebuild time.

savedSearchId.description: Meltwater saved search ID once persisted via listening_create_search. Null until the pillar's first onboarding/rebuild pass.

dimensions.description: Fixed dashboard rendering contract — must be exactly these five, in any order. Not brand-configurable: the dashboard's score columns and weighted-score formula key off these exact names.

weights.description: Per-brand weighting of the five fixed dimensions in the dashboard's weighted-score formula. Configurable; dimension names are not.

ops.description: Cost and cadence caps, set explicitly at onboarding time so a self-serve build can't run away on API cost.

builtFromSkeletonVersion.description: The skeleton repo tag this brand was last built/rebuilt from, e.g. "v1".

meltwaterAccountId.description: Meltwater account/workspace ID the saved searches live in.
